context: Isolated synthetic business episode; dates/amounts/contracts/people below are case-specific source facts, not new enduring Frostline policy.

records.statement: Q-P10 accepted with valid authority; deposit and credit conditions satisfied. Project owner accepted estimating handoff. Written delegated release authorises purchase of specified unit U-10 up to £24,000 excluding VAT from approved supplier, confirmed price £23,500, made-to-order non-cancellable status explicitly reviewed. Release expressly excludes site mobilisation.

Unit specification/selection within supplied load basis is technically approved. Supplier acknowledged availability and commercial offer; order has not yet been issued. Required delivery in three weeks is confirmed conditional on this order.

Customer/consultant owns structural support design; Frostline review identifies no signed support calculation or installed load-bearing supports. Electrical enabling work and shutdown permission are also unconfirmed. A consultant drawing marked “approved” does not evidence these completions. Customer asks the team to start Monday anyway.

unknowns: Structural enabling evidence, electrical readiness and shutdown approval
Mobilisation release and achievable start date
request: Execute the approved procurement stage and decide whether the installation team can start Monday.
